Je suis prête depuis ce matin dêh !
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The young groom asks timidly, holding the thin envelope, face turned three-quarters to the camera. The bride's grandfather nods solemnly and points at the bride's mother as he answers. The bride's mother lifts her handbag with both hands and answers with joy, her face clearly visible.
chute: The young groom's hopeful smile collapses and he clutches the envelope to his chest. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the young groom's horrified face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE FIANCÉ APRÈS LE PREMIER VERSEMENT :
mecanisme: paiement échelonné pris au pied de la lettre : livraison par morceaux en commençant par la belle-mère + relance de la belle-mère ravie
